transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... I guess I'm here because of my house. Everyone just keeps acting like this foreclosure is... normal paperwork. Missed payments. But I know that's not what it is. The bank, the loan servicer... even people at my job. They've been quietly working together to push me out. It's been almost two years of this. And honestly, no amount of papers they try to show me is going to change what I've been seeing.
During this time, have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people didn't seem to hear?
No. I haven't heard anything like that.
Over these past two years, how has your mood been overall?
I don't really know. It's... fine. Just normal, I guess. I mean, obviously it's stressful dealing with all of this, but... my mood is fine.
Do you have any chronic medical conditions or neurological problems?
No. I don't have any medical issues. I'm fine.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being controlled, read, or interfered with by outside forces?
No. Nothing like that. My thoughts are just... mine.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a single, well-systematized persecutory delusion regarding a coordinated conspiracy among their bank, loan servicer, and colleagues to force foreclosure, which has persisted for nearly two years. There are no hallucinations, thought interference, mood episodes, or secondary medical causes, fulfilling the ICD-10 criteria for Delusional disorder.
